hello.speaker: varrek
hello.text: Visitors. How long it has been since anyone climbed down here to bow. I am Varrek, and this hall belongs to the Hollow King. Which is to say: to me.

choices.text: (Speak the rite of unbinding carved on the altar.)
The Reeve's whole militia is on the stair behind me.

why.speaker: varrek
why.text: Because I was nobody. A hedge-wizard curing warts in the mere villages. And then I found a crown with no one in it. The dead do not laugh at me. The dead do as they are told.

choices.text: (Speak the rite of unbinding carved on the altar.)
They will stop when you do.

unbind.text: The words taste of dust and cold iron. The two dead things beside the altar fold up like dropped coats.

startled.speaker: varrek
startled.text: The militia? Here? They would not dare. They... how many?

do.text: He glances at the stair. It is all the opening you need.

mock.speaker: varrek
mock.text: Was that meant to frighten me? You stand in my hall and stammer. Kneel.

fight.speaker: varrek
fight.text: Then you will kneel the hard way.
